title: MV Steam Achievements for RPG Maker MV in 2025?

posts.author: emma_watson
posts.body:
Hi, I've completed my game and I am using
-NW.js 0.94
-Steamworks SDK 1.61
-Greenworks 0.19.0 (the greenworks for NWjs 0.94)
I am using
OrangeGreenworks
to attempt to get these achievements done.
As of now, after setting my folders up, I get this when I open up the console.
My question:
Has anyone done achievements for their RPG Maker MV game successfully recently? What greenworks, steam sdk, and nwjs did you use?
Should I just downgrade my nwjs back to 0.42, like from Freddy's original tutorial?
Anything extra?
That's it, thanks for reading this. I'd really like to not have to downgrade, since to my knowledge the newer nwjs has better performance on different systems and whatnot, but I'll do whatever it takes to get my achievements working. But I'd like to see what you guys have done. There's a surprising lack of Steam Achievement talk so I feel like people have been avoiding them entirely...

posts.author: bass2yang
posts.body:
Things to check are:
- make sure greenworks.js and steam_appid.txt (blank file I believe) are in the same path as your game's index.html and package.json file.
- Your lib folder which should also be in the same directory as the game should contain these files from Steam SDK 1.61 and Greenworks 0.19.0:
greenworks-win64.node
sdkencryptedappticket64.dll
sdkencryptedappticket64.lib
steam_api.dll
steam_api.lib
steam_api64.dll
steam_api64.lib
- Finally, Hudell's OrangeGreenworks should be in your plugins. (I added the line to show Hudell's OrangeGreenworks version).
- NWJS is 0.94.0, not 0.94.1 (which is the most recent one).
I do not have a deployed game, but the interface should at least work:
